scripts.studio: npm run audio && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run audio && remotion render src/index.ts RyhPromo out/ryh-promo.mp4 && npm run compress
scripts.compress: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/ryh-promo.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 27 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart out/ryh-promo-web.mp4
